title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Losses eat into your maintenance margin, and the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

translatedData.content:
My observation is this: when stolen funds are forced to rapidly rotate into other assets, MEV ordering rights can act like a toll booth, turning panic into revenue. This conclusion depends on whether Titan Builder’s revenue really came mainly from the transaction flow during that period, rather than merely reflecting accounting figures.

First, the facts. According to data from DefiLlama cited by PANews, Titan Builder earned $22.83 million in the past 24 hours, ranking first in protocol revenue. The same report said that, to convert freezeable stablecoins into assets such as ETH, the hacker made large purchases within an hour and paid about $119 million extra. At one point, the largest ETH/USDT pool on Ethereum was priced 38% above the market rate, drawing a rush of arbitrage bots. Bitquery estimated that tips paid to block builders that evening totaled 10,251 ETH, compared with 4.6 ETH at the same time the previous evening. These figures all come from a single media report, and the methodologies behind them vary by source, so their attribution should be retained.

In terms of how it works, builders determine the order of transactions within a block. The more concentrated and short-lived the arbitrage opportunity, the more bots are willing to tip for getting “on-chain first.” The more participants pay, the more valuable ordering rights become. My inference is that Titan’s surge in revenue looks more like a toll collected amid the chaos than a result of taking directional risk itself. The report says Titan does not trade on its own account; if true, that would make the revenue more akin to a fee for transaction flow.

But there are conditions under which this conclusion would not hold. If MEV tips in subsequent blocks fall rapidly, that would suggest this was a one-off event premium. If the hacker stops rotating assets or the funds are frozen, the source of transaction flow would also disappear. Evidence still missing includes the share of Titan’s revenue attributable to that period, the precise methodology for allocating tips, and whether independent data beyond Bitquery can corroborate the figures. The report’s claim that “two of the four crash-like revenue peaks came from other people’s disasters” is media narration, not an established pattern.

Worth tracking over the next few days are block-level MEV revenue, whether failed transaction counts return to normal, and whether builder market share changes following this exposure. This article does not constitute investment advice.

#ETH #USDT #稳定币 #CryptoSecurity

Sources:
PANews (originally published 10-31 at 13:30 Beijing time)

content:
我的观察是：被盗资金被迫高速换仓时，MEV排序权会像收费站一样把恐慌定价成收入。这个判断成立的前提是，Titan Builder的收入确实主要来自那段时间的排序流量，而不只是账面统计。

先交代事实。据PANews引用DefiLlama数据，Titan Builder近24小时收入2283万美元，排在协议收入榜第一。同一报道称，黑客为把可被冻结的稳定币换成ETH等资产，在一个小时内完成大额买入，多付约1.19亿美元；以太坊最大ETH/USDT池一度比市场价高38%，机器人蜂拥套利，Bitquery统计当晚付给区块构建者的小费达10251枚ETH，前一晚同期为4.6枚。这些数字都来自单一媒体报道，统计口径也各有来源，需要保留归属。

机制上，构建者决定区块内交易的顺序。套利机会越集中、越短命，机器人越愿意为“先上链”付小费；付的人越多，排序权就越值钱。我的推断是，Titan的暴增收入更像是这场混乱的过路费，而不是它主动承担了方向性风险——报道称它不做自营交易，这一点若属实，收入性质就更接近流量收费。

但这个判断有失效条件。若后续区块的MEV小费快速回落，说明这只是一次性事件溢价；若黑客换仓暂停或资产被冻结，流量源头也会消失。还缺的证据是：Titan收入中来自该时段的占比、小费分配的具体口径，以及除Bitquery外是否有独立数据交叉验证。报道中“四次崩盘式收入峰值里两次来自别人的灾难”属于媒体叙述，不能当作已证实的规律。

值得跟踪的是后续几日的区块MEV收入、失败交易数是否回归常态，以及构建者份额是否因这次曝光发生变化。本文不构成投资建议。

As of noon Beijing time on October 31, Ethereum was trading at $2,239, down slightly by about 0.17% over the past 24 hours, showing relatively strong resilience. The price gradually declined from around $2,250 to a low of $2,237, before recovering slightly. Compared with Bitcoin’s larger swings, Ethereum has shown greater resilience amid current market turmoil, largely thanks to a stabilizing effect from exchange buybacks and continued accumulation by institutional wallets.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

On the hourly chart, Ethereum is currently trading below key moving averages. The 7-period moving average is around $2,244, the 25-period moving average around $2,239, and the 99-period moving average around $2,305. Short-term moving averages are beginning to flatten, but the long-term average overhead continues to act as resistance. The Bollinger Band’s upper, middle, and lower bands are around $2,252, $2,239, and $2,227, respectively. The price is right at the middle band, indicating a balance between bulls and bears.

The MACD indicator shows the DIF line at around -5.52, the DEA line at around -8.45, and the histogram at a positive 2.93. Although MACD remains below the zero line, the histogram has stayed positive and is gradually expanding, suggesting that bullish momentum is slowly building. The 6-period RSI is around 50, the 12-period RSI around 48, and the 24-period RSI around 45, placing them all in neutral territory. Among the KDJ indicators, the K line has fallen to 51, the D line to 59, and the J line to 33, suggesting short-term oversold conditions.

In terms of combined signals, 8 of the 15 factors indicate a short position, 6 indicate a long position, and 1 is neutral. The short signal share is 53.3%, notably more moderate than Bitcoin’s 66.7%. Although the composite indicator points to a short-term bearish bias, its historical win rate is 76.6%, suggesting relatively high signal reliability. ATR has fallen from 19.6 to 15.9, indicating narrowing volatility and likewise suggesting that a directional move may be approaching.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s main source of pressure is outflows from spot ETFs. On October 30, they recorded net outflows of $155.7 million, continuing a trend of capital flight that has lasted for several weeks. This reflects institutional investors’ cautious stance amid current uncertainty. Meanwhile, funds from security incidents that have yet to be recovered may be at risk of being sold off, while security concerns surrounding the EIP-7702 delegation standard have added further uncertainty to the market.

However, several positive factors are helping support Ethereum. First, major exchanges have pledged to use treasury reserves to buy back Ethereum through over-the-counter transactions and open-market purchases, effectively stabilizing the spot price. Second, newly identified institution-linked wallets have withdrawn tens of thousands of ETH, absorbing some of the excess supply. Third, the THORChain ecosystem has drawn attention following a fund-movement incident, and its RUNE token has risen 13%. Increased activity across the cross-chain ecosystem indirectly benefits Ethereum. Fourth, ICE (the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange) announced a partnership with Hyperliquid to build an on-chain perpetual futures product. Traditional finance’s endorsement of on-chain infrastructure has added long-term confidence to the broader Ethereum ecosystem.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What’s the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They support each other in the basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won’t spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you’re not yet able to assess the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

translatedData.content:
When my account was showing unrealized gains, I was quicker than anyone to act, afraid they’d disappear; when I was sitting on losses, I wouldn’t budge, thinking they’d eventually come back.

Only later did I realize it wasn’t a personality flaw. Losing a given amount of money feels about twice as bad as gaining the same amount feels good.

So your brain makes the choice for you: take a small profit and bank it, but refuse to accept a loss.

The result is exactly backward—you don’t hold on to the gains you should, and you keep hanging on to the losses you should accept.

Now I do just one thing: before placing an order, I write down what this money is for and how much of a loss I’m willing to accept.

Once I’ve written it down, the pain has a lot less power to steer me.

$ETH: ETH: Understanding the Depth of Liquid Movement

Evaluating $ETH requires a clear understanding of liquidity, which describes how easily an asset moves between hands without causing massive price shifts. Currently, the $ETH price sits above resistance. While the hourly direction is up and the volume is above baseline, these metrics tell us more about current participation than future certainty.

Think of liquidity as a swimming pool. If the pool is deep, a person jumping in barely changes the water level. This is high liquidity, where large market orders are absorbed easily. If the pool is a tiny backyard basin, that same jump splashes water everywhere. In crypto, when volume is above baseline, we are seeing the splashing in real time. 

We must distinguish a scenario from an observation. Observing the RSI at 64.5237 and the daily change of 0.997064 shows us recent momentum, but it does not reveal the hidden limit orders waiting in the books. Market orders eat through existing liquidity, while limit orders provide it. When buyers rush in, they can push the price through resistance quickly if the sell-side depth is thin. 

To reassess this interpretation, one should look at the spread and how the price reacts after the initial surge. If $ETH stays above 2238.57 even as volume settles, it may suggest that new limit orders are forming a firmer floor. Watching the MACD at 1.78144 alongside 2.52194 helps us see if the movement is supported by sustained interest or just a brief splash in a shallow pool. 💧

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十月三十一日，以太坊现货价格报两千两百四十九点七七美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之零点六，走势略强于比特币。从小时K线来看，ETH在最近五个交易小时内从两千两百四十四美元温和上涨至两千两百五十四美元，价格沿着布林带中轨两千两百四十三美元上方稳步运行，目前逼近布林带上轨两千两百五十三美元，短线存在突破尝试的意愿。七周期均线两千两百四十六美元上穿二十五周期均线两千两百四十一美元，短期均线多头排列初步形成。然而价格仍远低于九十九周期均线两千三百美元和超级趋势线两千两百七十七美元，中期弱势格局未改。

二、技术指标解读

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget all the rules, so I wrote them down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don't trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution went off track. Let’s keep each other accountable.

After fiat is deposited into an exchange, is there enough money in the corresponding “safeguarding account”? The Central Bank of Ireland has just fined Coinbase’s Irish entity approximately €3.25 million.

According to the Central Bank of Ireland’s (CBI) announcement on October 22 and the settlement notice agreed with Coinbase Ireland Limited on October 21, the period of non-compliance ran from approximately November 1, 2020, to August 19, 2025, and involved safeguarding customer funds and outsourcing governance under the Electronic Money Regulations. Here are a few points of direct relevance to ordinary customers👇

🔹 Fine: Originally set at approximately €4.647 million, it was reduced by a 30% settlement discount to €3,252,618, with a reprimand also imposed; it will take effect only after confirmation by the High Court.
🔹 Core issue: The designated safeguarding account was underfunded for an extended period; safeguarding processes relied excessively on outsourcing to the US group, while ongoing local oversight of customer funds was inadequate.
🔹 Role of the entity: Coinbase Ireland is an electronic money institution responsible for issuing and redeeming electronic money on the fiat side. Customers then use this electronic money to buy and sell crypto assets on the group’s trading platform.
🔹 The company has admitted the relevant breaches. The regulator stressed that electronic money institutions must properly safeguard customer funds; outsourcing does not replace local responsibility.

The “safeguarding account” rules for EU-licensed entities essentially ask: Is there enough money held separately behind the fiat balance you see on your account? The fine has yet to be formally finalized, but the message is already clear—safeguarding customer funds is not optional.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year gives you 12 times your starting capital; earning a steady 10% a month
gives you 30 times your starting capital over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one magical quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You have to wait for the market to turn in your favor, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
but the ability to achieve the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

translatedData.content:
ETH authorization details emerge｜Separate signature risks from public-chain risks｜Hold above $2,260 before considering participation

My stance is to watch cautiously and not assume that this platform hot-wallet incident means Ethereum’s mainnet was compromised just because “the hackers used an Ethereum feature.” Binance’s October 29 security announcement confirmed that approximately $6.3 billion in assets were affected, and said it had arranged to cover user losses with company funds and would restore withdrawals in stages; the investigation is ongoing. TRM Labs subsequently offered a more specific technical analysis of the on-chain activity: the attackers used the EIP-7702 delegation mechanism in Ethereum-related transactions, together with around 50 pre-signed authorizations, to make the affected wallets sweep funds. The “around 50” figure is TRM’s analytical finding, not Binance’s finalized determination of the root cause. How the authorizations were obtained and which parts of the system were breached remain questions to be answered by the platform’s investigation.

EIP-7702 itself allows accounts to delegate code execution under authorization, and the standard documentation also highlights the security boundaries around signatures and delegation targets. In other words, the mechanism provides the ability to execute code; whether an attack can occur depends on valid authorization and whether relevant risk controls are breached. Calling this an “ETH protocol vulnerability” would be misleading. However, if there are weaknesses in the signing process or delegation-permission management, exchanges and wallet providers alike need to reassess how authorizations are displayed, limited, revoked, and monitored for suspicious transactions. For the market, what truly affects ETH’s valuation is users’ trust in the security of on-chain interactions and institutions’ repricing of custody risk—not an unverified conclusion that the mainnet malfunctioned.

The price has responded relatively calmly: when I checked ETH/USD on Kraken, it was around $2,248, with a 24-hour low of about $2,204 and a high of about $2,259. It remains near the top of the day’s range, but there is not enough evidence to say the security details have been fully priced in. The $2,259–$2,260 area is the short-term threshold for whether buyers can continue to provide support, while $2,204 is the intraday line of defense. I would abandon my relatively neutral view if subsequent official disclosures expand the scope of losses, withdrawals resume significantly more slowly than planned, or ETH breaks below $2,204 and fails to rebound. If the investigation reduces uncertainty and the price holds near the top of its range, I would then consider whether risk appetite is gradually recovering.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I would only consider a conditional, small spot position on the long side, with no leveraged futures. I would enter in stages using 3% of my total capital only if ETH closes above $2,260 for two consecutive one-hour candles and Binance publishes verifiable progress on recovery. The first target would be $2,295, where I would take half off; the second target would be $2,340, with the remainder exited in stages. I would set a stop-loss at an approximately 2% price pullback from entry. I would also close the position proactively if ETH falls back below $2,259 and fails to recover that level on a one-hour close. If these conditions are never met, I would remain in cash. content:
ETH授权细节浮出水面｜先分清签名风险与公链风险｜站稳2260美元再谈参与

我的态度是谨慎观察，暂不因为“黑客用了以太坊功能”就把这次平台热钱包事件理解成以太坊主网被攻破。币安10月29日的安全公告确认约63亿美元资产受到影响，并说明已为用户损失安排公司资金覆盖、分阶段恢复提现；调查仍在继续。TRM Labs随后给出的链上分析提出更具体的技术路径：攻击者在以太坊相关交易中利用EIP-7702委托机制，配合约50份预先签署的授权，让受影响的钱包执行扫转。这里的“约50份”是TRM的分析结果，不是币安已经完成的最终根因认定；授权如何取得、哪些系统环节失守，还应等待平台后续调查。

EIP-7702本身允许账户在授权条件下委托代码执行，标准文档也提示签名与委托目标的安全边界。换句话说，机制提供了执行能力，攻击能否发生取决于有效授权和相关风控是否被突破。把它直接写成“ETH协议漏洞”会误导判断；但若签名流程或委托权限管理存在薄弱环节，交易所与钱包服务商都需要重新审视授权展示、限额、撤销与异常交易拦截。对市场而言，真正影响ETH估值的，是用户对链上交互安全的信任和机构对托管风险的重新定价，而不是一个未经证实的主网故障结论。

价格已经给出相对克制的反馈：查看Kraken ETH/USD时，现价约2248美元，24小时低点约2204美元、高点约2259美元，仍在日内区间上沿附近，没有足够证据称安全细节已经完全消化。2259至2260美元是我看多方能否继续承接的短线门槛，2204美元是日内防线。若后续官方披露扩大损失范围、提现恢复明显慢于计划，或ETH跌破2204美元且反弹无力，我会推翻偏中性的判断；若调查缩小不确定性并稳住区间上沿，才考虑风险偏好逐步修复。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向上仅准备有条件的小仓位现货做多，不做合约加杠杆。只有ETH连续两根一小时K线收在2260美元上方，同时币安公布可核验的恢复进展，才用总资金的3%分批入场；第一目标2295美元，达到后减掉一半，第二目标2340美元，余仓分段退出。入场后以约2%的价格回撤为止损，若再跌回2259美元下方且一小时不能收复，也主动平仓；若条件始终不满足就保持空仓。这个计划尚未触发，更没有可复盘的成交或收益。

Wallet & Security | Address Poisoning
What it is: Address poisoning is when an attacker creates a lookalike address with the same beginning and ending as an address you often use, then slips it into your transaction history.
How to understand it: Address poisoning doesn’t require stealing your private key or getting you to sign an authorization. It exploits the habit of copying addresses from transaction history and checking only the first and last characters.
Reminder: Add frequently used recipient addresses to your address book or withdrawal whitelist, and select them from your address book each time. Don’t copy them from your transaction history.

subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You’re Stuck Holding a Position, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. By separating your decision from your position, you can see clearly

Binance and Musk are bound to clash sooner or later, and AI is precisely a key variable behind this battle. I think I wrote something like this a year ago: every old-school internet app is going to be impacted.

Because AI is changing the most fundamental thing in an industry: the necessity of intermediaries.

The internet business model used to follow a basic logic: if users needed information, they went through search engines; if they needed to make transactions, they went through trading platforms; if they needed financial services, they went through financial institutions; and if they needed traffic, they went through social platforms.

Intermediaries at every layer could profit from information asymmetry, traffic distribution, transaction matching, and user relationships. But AI is gradually changing this structure.

AI will swallow up a lot of intermediaries, as users’ points of entry shift from apps to AI agents.

The internet will also move from the early era of technological feudal monopolies to an era of imperial expansionism.

After 3 years of futures trading, here’s the truth I learned about why 90% of people lose money (save this)

Main text:

Many people think they can’t make money in crypto because their “technical skills aren’t good enough.” But after looking at hundreds, even thousands, of liquidation records, I discovered the truth is much harsher: most people don’t fail because of their trading skills—they fail because of human nature.

If you’re feeling lost in your trading right now, you’ve probably fallen into at least 2 of these 4 traps:

1️⃣ Betting big and treating the market like a casino

You’re more patient than anyone when holding onto a losing position, but quicker than anyone to take profits. You take small gains and stubbornly hold onto losses. Your risk-reward ratio is completely out of balance, and one black swan event can wipe you out.

2️⃣ Trading too frequently and “working for” the platform

Opening dozens of trades a day only amplifies your emotions. You ignore the trend and focus only on minute-by-minute charts, until all your profits end up going to fees.

3️⃣ Chasing highs blindly and trading emotionally

You see a coin surge 100% and jump in, thinking it can double again—only to buy right at the top. Always remember: stay calm when others are celebrating, and look for opportunities when others are panicking.

4️⃣ Having no stop-loss plan and relying entirely on gut feeling

You never set a stop-loss before opening a position, always thinking, “It can still bounce back.” Trading isn’t about who makes the most money; it’s about who can stay in the game the longest.

💡 3 survival tips for beginners:

Start small: Never let the loss on a single trade exceed 2% of your total capital.

Build a system: Only trade markets you understand. If you don’t understand them, stay out and observe.

Enter in stages: Learn to take profits and cut losses in stages, keeping control in your own hands.

What’s the hardest thing for you to overcome in trading right now?

A. I can’t resist going in too big

B. I can’t hold onto profits

C. I stubbornly hold onto losing positions

D. I often chase highs

Leave your answer in the comments, or tell us about the biggest trap you’ve fallen into! 👇

title: 🚨 Binance’s $6.3B Security Crisis: A Stress Test for Crypto’s Financial System
subTitle:
When a major crypto exchange faces a multibillion-dollar security crisis, the real question is not just how much money was lost. It is whether the market can maintain trust when that institution comes under pressure.
On October 30, 2026, Binance reported a serious security incident involving unauthorized withdrawals from its hot wallets, with an estimated impact of approximately $6.3 billion. The exchange says it will cover the losses through its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) and corporate treasury.
The incident deserves attention beyond crypto traders. It raises important questions about institutional risk, market liquidity, regulatory coordination, and the future of centralized exchanges.
💰 The Numbers Investors Need to Watch
According to Binance’s official update:
$6.3 billion: Estimated value of the affected assets.
$6.34 billion+: Funds Binance says it has set aside to cover the impact.
$5 billion: Corresponding token assets reportedly already secured, covering approximately 80% of the affected amount.
$3 billion: Assets Binance says have been frozen on-chain through coordination with industry partners and relevant authorities.
Binance has also said it is acquiring the remaining corresponding tokens and working to restore withdrawals following additional security checks. These figures reflect the company's statements; the full incident investigation remains ongoing.
One distinction matters: frozen funds are not necessarily recovered funds, and allocated reserves are not the same as completed reimbursement. Investors should watch for independently verifiable evidence of the final outcome.
🌍 The Geopolitical Dimension: Who Controls the Money?
Crypto is often described as a borderless financial system. But when a major security incident occurs, the response depends heavily on institutions with real-world power.
Law enforcement agencies can investigate transactions. Blockchain intelligence firms can trace asset movements. Stablecoin issuers may be able to freeze tokens under their control, while exchanges can restrict suspicious accounts and coordinate recovery efforts.
This creates an important power dynamic: blockchain transactions may be publicly traceable, but the ability to intervene depends on the asset, network, and relevant institutions.
For governments, incidents of this scale can strengthen arguments for stricter exchange oversight, cybersecurity standards, and international cooperation. For the industry, the challenge is to improve accountability without unnecessarily restricting legitimate financial activity.
The policy response matters because tighter regulation can increase compliance costs while potentially making the market more accessible to institutional investors.
📊 What Does This Mean for Institutional Capital?
Large investors do not evaluate crypto solely by looking at token prices. They also assess custody arrangements, counterparty exposure, liquidity, operational controls, and the ability to withdraw assets when needed.
A major exchange security incident can trigger three reactions:
1. Short-term risk reduction
Some traders may move assets off exchanges, reduce leverage, or hold more cash and stablecoins. If selling accelerates, BTC and ETH could face additional pressure, although the actual impact will depend on broader market conditions.
2. A shift in capital allocation
Institutional investors may reconsider how much exposure they keep with a single exchange. This could increase interest in diversified custody, regulated financial infrastructure, and stronger proof-of-reserves practices.
3. A longer-term test of confidence
If Binance demonstrates that it can cover the affected losses, restore services safely, and provide credible verification, it may limit the damage to user confidence. If important commitments are delayed or the investigation reveals deeper weaknesses, concerns could persist.
None of these outcomes is guaranteed. They are scenarios investors should monitor.
₿ BTC, ETH, BNB and Stablecoins: The Market Map
Bitcoin ($BTC ): Watch price action, trading volume, and derivatives positioning. A security-driven sell-off could create additional volatility, but it does not automatically invalidate Bitcoin's long-term investment case.
Ethereum ($ETH ): Monitor ETH's reaction alongside BTC. Broad market deleveraging can pressure both assets, while network fundamentals and overall liquidity remain important independent factors.
BNB: Binance-related uncertainty may affect sentiment toward BNB. However, the extent of any impact will depend on the token's market structure, actual exchange exposure, and subsequent disclosures.
USDT and $USDC : Stablecoins deserve particular attention because they play a central role in crypto trading liquidity. Investors should distinguish between the stability of a stablecoin itself and the operational risks associated with holding it on an exchange.
🔎 The Investor's Logical Map
Here is how political decisions and institutional responses could affect a portfolio:
Security incident → regulatory scrutiny → possible compliance changes → shifts in institutional capital → changes in liquidity and market volatility.
The process can also run in the opposite direction.
A credible recovery, transparent disclosures, and stronger security controls could help restore confidence. Clearer regulation could eventually attract additional institutional participation, although that outcome depends on the rules and how they are implemented.
For investors, the practical lesson is to monitor both policy developments and market data rather than reacting to headlines alone.
🎯 Bullish vs. Bearish Scenarios
Bullish scenario: Binance fulfills its stated commitments, provides convincing reserve verification, restores withdrawals safely, and publishes credible findings. Confidence stabilizes, and broader crypto markets may recover if macroeconomic conditions also support risk assets.
Bearish scenario: The investigation uncovers additional vulnerabilities, withdrawals face prolonged disruption, or uncertainty spreads to other platforms. Risk aversion could increase, liquidity could deteriorate, and leveraged positions could face further liquidations.
What should investors do?
Avoid panic-selling solely because of a headline, but do not dismiss operational risk either. Keep leverage under control, diversify custody where practical, and verify important announcements through official channels.
Remember that proof of reserves is useful, but it does not automatically establish a complete picture of liabilities, solvency, or operational security.
🧠 Final Takeaway
Binance's response will be judged by more than the amount of capital it says it has allocated. The decisive factors are whether affected users are made whole, withdrawals resume safely, the incident is independently verifiable, and the underlying security weaknesses are addressed.
For long-term investors, this is a reminder that crypto investment risk includes not only price volatility, but also custody, institutional reliability, regulation, and access to liquidity.
The strongest investment decisions come from separating verified facts from market speculation and managing risk before volatility arrives.
Your turn: Do you believe Binance's commitment to cover the affected funds will restore market confidence, or could this incident accelerate the shift toward self-custody and decentralized trading? Share your analysis below.

title: BINANCE SECURITY
subTitle:
🔐 Binance Security: Protect Your Crypto, Protect Your Future!
In the world of cryptocurrency, security is one of the most important things every investor should understand.

As crypto adoption continues to grow, online threats, phishing attacks, fake websites, and scams are also becoming more common.

Binance Security is not just about protecting an account; it's about building trust and creating a safer crypto environment.

Here are five important ways to protect your Binance account:

1. Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Add an extra layer of protection so that your password alone isn't enough to access your account.

2. Use a Strong Password

Never use the same password for multiple platforms. Create a unique and difficult password.

3. Beware of Fake Links

Always check website addresses and use official Binance channels. Never trust suspicious messages promising free rewards.

4. Activate Anti-Phishing Code

Use Binance's anti-phishing feature to help identify genuine emails from Binance.

5. Protect Your Private Information

Many people can't bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that 'I was wrong,' and their pride
can't get past it. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional and a gambler isn't who is more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most disciplined trader I've ever seen cuts losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

ETH withdrawal timeline draws attention | Official says services will resume coin by coin | Don’t chase above $2,259

My stance is to remain cautious and wait for verifiable withdrawal status. Binance Square is currently discussing “He Yi says withdrawals are expected to resume within the next 42 hours,” but I won’t treat that countdown as a confirmed reopening time. The official security update co-signed by He Yi and Richard Teng says the technical team is working to restore services within the roughly 34-hour target announced earlier, provided security checks are completed, with services resuming in phases by coin. The starting points and publication times of the two statements may differ. What traders can actually verify is the official announcement specifying which networks and coins are available, whether a small withdrawal can be completed from their own account, and subsequent proof of reserves. Until these points are verified, we cannot claim that ETH withdrawals have fully resumed.

The incident itself also needs to be considered in stages: Binance says the hot-wallet attack involved about $6.3 billion in assets, that it has set aside over $6.34 billion in company funds, and that it will cover the losses; assets worth about $5 billion in the affected coins are ready, while the remainder is still being acquired. The roughly $3 billion frozen on-chain has not necessarily been returned. The company also plans to release proof-of-reserves results by November 2. The Associated Press reported on the attack and funding arrangements, but funding, reserve verification, and users ultimately receiving their assets are separate milestones. For ETH, the resumption of deposits and withdrawals on the platform directly affects cross-platform arbitrage and spot-market depth. If the resumption is slower than expected, localized price spreads and selling pressure may persist; if services resume smoothly in phases, the liquidity discount may have a chance to narrow. This is an analysis of trading mechanics, not a claim that the ETH mainnet has experienced a fault.

Kraken currently shows ETH/USD at around $2,242, with a 24-hour low of about $2,204 and a high of about $2,259. Although the price has rebounded from its low, it has not broken through the intraday ceiling, so the rebound alone is not enough to confirm that the risk has been priced in. Another independent data point is Farside’s tally showing net outflows of about $155.7 million from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on October 30. That is a headwind from fund flows and cannot be directly attributed to this security incident. If the price repeatedly fails to break through around $2,259, chasing it offers poor risk-reward; if it falls below $2,204, that would indicate that support remains weak. My view would be invalidated if the official announcement confirms that ETH-related withdrawal channels are resuming in phases, fund verification is available, and the price holds above $2,259. If the official reopening is delayed or the price drops below $2,204, I will continue to reduce risk exposure.

If I were trading this myself, I would not take a directional position now. I would keep cash in my spot portfolio and avoid leverage. Only after the official announcement that ETH withdrawals have resumed, and two consecutive one-hour candles close and hold above $2,259, would I use no more than 6% of my total capital to test a long position. The first target is $2,290; I would take half off when it is reached. The second target is $2,340, with a trailing stop raised on the remaining position. I would set the initial stop about 2% below the entry price. If the price falls back below $2,204 or there is a major reversal in withdrawal progress, I would close the position early. If the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade—and I won’t pretend that waiting is a profit.

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与方向单，现货保留现金，不开杠杆。只有官方公布ETH对应提币恢复，且价格在2259美元上方连续两根一小时K线收稳，才用总资金不超过6%试多；第一目标2290，触及先减半，第二目标2340，剩余仓位跟随抬高止损。初始止损设在入场价下方约2%，若重新跌回2204下方或提币进展出现重大反复，就提前平仓。没有触发就没有成交，更不会把等待写成收益。

When I first started out, I always thought that a long/short ratio above 1 meant there were more long positions than short positions across the whole market. It took me a while to understand: every long position has a short position on the other side, so the total number of longs and shorts across the market is always equal. A long-leaning account ratio simply means more accounts are taking long positions, while the short positions are held by fewer accounts.
A heavily skewed long/short ratio can persist for quite a long time. Placing contrarian trades based on the ratio alone can often be costly.
Working backward from where to place your stop-loss to determine your position size is much more reliable than just guessing.

Ash Crypto has 2.15 million followers. One line—"They 100% know something"—got 35,000 views. Twelve minutes later, accounts were reposting it word for word, with 🚨BREAKING slapped on the front.

There’s nothing wrong with the data itself: ETH margin longs on Bitfinex have climbed from around 82,000 to roughly 390,000 over the past few weeks, the highest in more than four years. Some put the value at around $875 million. The last time positions piled up like this was June 2022, after which ETH doubled. That line has now become a shield for every account calling for a rally.

But I genuinely don’t understand where “100% know” came from.

These Bitfinex positions are leveraged margin longs, not spot buying. At the same time, Binance ETH perpetual funding rates were negative; someone posted a figure of about -0.011. Perpetuals leaning bearish while Bitfinex leans bullish—one of the simplest explanations is that someone borrowed coins to go long while opening a short on the other side in perpetuals to hedge or collect funding. If you mistake the hedging leg for a whale betting on a rally, that’s just your own imagination.

Meanwhile, real money is flowing out. Spot ETH ETFs saw $155.85 million in net outflows on October 30, their fifth consecutive day of outflows, bringing October’s total to $1.61 billion. ETH is hovering around $2,240, and it just lost two 50-week moving averages on the weekly chart.

I’m not saying it has to fall. It’s just that the same indicator had someone posting yesterday, “After Bitfinex longs hit a new high, the market dumped.” Once crowded longs break support, they become the perfect fuel.

Post a screenshot with “They definitely know something,” and if you’re right, you’re a prophet; if you’re wrong, you’re not responsible. The whale might be right, but the people hyping the trade are making money from your clicks, not from that position.

#ETH #Bitfinex

Let’s talk about public blockchains and the blockchain trilemma.
A Layer 1 is a blockchain that handles its own consensus and settlement, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.
One thing many people overlook: the more distributed the validator nodes are, the more messages they need to exchange to reach consensus, making it harder to improve performance. This is what causes the three goals to constrain one another.
When you see a public blockchain advertised as offering “second-level confirmations and virtually no fees,” first ask what trade-offs it has made.
$ETH  is the native token of Ethereum, a Layer 1 public blockchain. It is used to pay gas fees and for staking.

After hearing about the crackdown on scam compounds, are casinos in Cambodia still raking in U? Blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs has laid out the numbers: 34 brick-and-mortar casinos in Sihanoukville received a combined total of about $1.07 billion in crypto assets in the first nine months of this year.

A few points that directly affect ordinary people 👇

🔹 Period and scope: The data covers January 1 to September 7, 2026. TRM tracked deposit addresses attributable to brick-and-mortar casinos in Sihanoukville—not all of Cambodia, nor every on-chain label related to casinos.
🔹 Share linked to sanctioned entities: About $687 million (roughly 64%) flowed into casinos connected to networks sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury’s OFAC. Three casinos alone received a combined total of more than $320 million after being added to the sanctions list.
🔹 Almost all of it was USDT on TRON: About 99.9% of deposits were TRON-based USDT. Average monthly deposits fell from about $148 million in January–May to about $95 million in July–August, but they didn’t stop. TRM also cautioned that address rotation may make the decline appear larger than it really is.
🔹 Cash-out channels are still operating: Casino cashier counters continue to accept USDT in exchange for chips or cash; pawnshops, supermarkets, and exchange points are also offering crypto-to-cash services. On September 8, Cambodia’s anti-scam committee said it had revoked 18 casino licenses and suspended 9, but the cash-out channels have not disappeared as a result.
🔹 What this means for you: TRON-USDT sent from unfamiliar addresses and opaque “collect-and-pay” services can more easily trigger sanctions and anti-money-laundering monitoring. Exchanges and stablecoin issuers will also step up screening for indirect exposure. This isn’t to scare you off using U—it’s a warning not to act as a fiat-currency courier.

Put simply: this is a data post saying, “The entities are on the sanctions list and the compounds are being cleared, but the casinos’ USDT cash-out pipeline is still breathing”—not a prediction that any particular blockchain is about to collapse. What really matters is where the USDT you receive came from, and whether anyone checks your identity when you cash it out.

Are you more worried about “unknown U landing in your wallet and triggering risk controls,” or “Southeast Asian cash-out channels continuing to evade the lists”? Let’s talk in the comments 👇

听说「打压诈骗园区」之后，柬埔寨那边的赌场还在狂收 U？链上分析公司 TRM Labs 把账摊开了——西哈努克市 34 家实体赌场，今年前九个月合计收了约 10.7 亿美元加密资产。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 时间与口径：统计区间是 2026 年 1 月 1 日到 9 月 7 日；TRM 追踪的是西哈努克市可归因到线下赌场的入金地址，不是全柬埔寨、也不是链上所有赌场类标签
🔹 制裁关联占比：约 6.87 亿美元（约 64%）流入与美国财政部 OFAC 已制裁网络相关的赌场；其中三家实体在各自被列入制裁名单之后，仍合计收了超过 3.2 亿美元
🔹 几乎全是 TRON 上的 USDT：入金里约 99.9% 是波场 USDT；月均入金从 1–5 月约 1.48 亿美元，降到 7–8 月约 9500 万美元，但没有停——TRM 也提醒，地址轮换可能让降幅看起来比实际更大
🔹 兑现金的方式还在：赌场收银台继续收 USDT 换筹码/现金，当铺、超市、兑换点也在做「币换现」；柬埔寨反诈委员会 9 月 8 日称已吊销 18 张赌场牌照、暂停 9 张，但兑付通道并未因此消失
🔹 对你意味着什么：陌生地址转来的 TRON-USDT、来路不明的「代收代付」，更容易踩到制裁与洗钱监控；交易所和稳定币发行方也会加强间接敞口筛查——不是吓你别用 U，是别当法币搬运工

说白了：这是「制裁名单上了、园区也在清，但赌场兑 U 的管道还在喘」的数据帖，不是喊某条链要崩。真正要盯的是——你收到的 USDT 从哪来、换现有没有人核对你是谁。

The bigger picture is still cautious. ETH trades well below the MA(25) at $2,302 and the MA(99) at $2,373, and both are sloping down. Until price reclaims those levels, the higher-timeframe structure leans bearish.

Levels I’m watching:

Support: $2,208, then $2,174, then the $2,163 area
Resistance: $2,262, then the $2,300 to $2,330 zone, then $2,391

The long wick near $2,174 shows buyers defended that area, but one defended low isn’t a trend reversal. A strong close above $2,300 would be the first real sign of strength. A close below $2,208 would put the wick low back in play.

For now, patience beats prediction. Let the chart confirm before committing, and keep your risk managed.

title: 10月31日 晚间盘 10币全景：BTC 二测 76325 未破，缩量磨底等美盘
subTitle:
【一句话定调】
周末缩量磨底。十币 24h 五涨五跌，涨跌幅全部收在 ±4% 内，4h 只有 BTC、BNB、LINK 微红。BTC 二次下探 76325.98 与 30 日低点完全重合却未破，空头动能正在衰减，但没人接力做多——这是横盘，不是反转。

【大盘：$BTC】
77457，24h -0.29%，12h +0.63%，4h +0.09%。欧盘时段基本走平，价格贴在 77634 的布林下轨外侧，位置 -2.6%，属于偏离带外的弱势整理。
均线全空：MA7 79339、MA25 81463 依次压在头上，价格距 MA25 -4.92%；唯一支撑是 MA99 76442，离现价只有 1.3%，与 30 日低点 76326 构成 76300–76450 的密集防线。
RSI14 34.8，未进 30 以下的极端区；MACD 柱 -524，仍在零轴下方但幅度收敛。ATR 1962、波动率 2.53%，是十币里最低的一档——大资金没动。
24h 高点 78110 是今晚第一道压力，站上才谈修复；30 日区间分位仅 10.4%，往上还有 11.19% 才到 30 日高 87220。

【二线梯队：$ETH SOL XRP】
ETH 2245.72，24h +0.79%，是三大权重里唯一收红的。但结构仍弱：失守 MA99 2346.70 已第三天，MA7 2301 反压，布林位置 2.5% 贴着下轨 2238.66。RSI 30.1 已到超卖边缘，4h 却只有 -0.01%，说明抛压和承接都在枯竭。30 日低 2174.08 是隔夜必须守的线。
SOL 95.57，24h -1.23%，十币里跌幅最大。跌破布林下轨 96.01，位置 -3.3%，MA99 98.29 已失守，RSI 30.3。30 日低 92.34 还有 3.4% 空间，是最容易在弱流动性里被插针的标的。
XRP 1.2489，24h -0.35%，4h 与 12h 都是 -0.35%，横成一条直线。布林下轨 1.2433 就在脚下，30 日低 1.2002 尚有 3.9% 缓冲，RSI 36.8。这种无量横盘一旦选择方向，幅度会比 ATR 4.16% 更大。

【平台与支付：$BNB TON】
BNB 702.83，24h +0.05%，4h +0.09%，12h +0.37%，走势最稳。价格站在 MA99 699.13 上方 0.5%，布林位置 4.1%，30 日区间分位 17.6%，是十币里位置最高的之一。RSI 38.3、MACD 柱 -3.41 都在中性偏弱区，既没有超跌反弹的势能，也没有破位风险——典型的防守型品种。24h 低 694 与 MA99 699 构成 694–699 的下沿。
TON 1.60，24h +0.95%，是唯二 MACD 柱翻正的币（+0.0036）。但量能只有七日均量的 5%，这个红是失真的：4h -0.99%、12h -0.56% 已经回吐。布林位置 33.2% 为十币最高，30 日低 1.443 未破，属于弱反弹而非趋势。

【高弹性尾部：DOGE ADA AVAX LINK】
DOGE 0.0751，24h -0.48%，4h -0.46%，12h -0.66%，三周期同向走弱。布林下轨 0.0745 与 24h 低 0.07452 几乎重合，30 日低 0.0722 是最后一道。RSI 34.7，MACD 柱仅 -0.00015，动能已经很小，缺的只是买盘。
ADA 0.1929，24h +0.1% 但 12h -0.77%，是典型的欧盘冲高回落。距 MA25 0.2211 有 -12.77%，十币里偏离最深；30 日区间分位 10.9%，距 30 日高 0.2824 已 -31.69%，跌幅最惨。布林下轨 0.1884 就在 2.3% 之外。
AVAX 8.429，24h -0.78%，4h -1.02% 跌幅居前。MA99 8.389 仅差 0.47%，30 日低 8.0 还有 5.1%。量能 0.46 倍是尾部里最活跃的，说明这里有人在换手。
LINK 11.474，24h +3.92% 领涨全场，4h +0.17%、12h +1.02%，是全篇唯一三周期全红的币。站上 MA7 11.403 与 MA99 11.367，布林位置 27.5%、30 日分位 27.4% 均为最高，RSI 43.1 也是最高。24h 高 11.749 是今晚关键，突破则打开 12.99 上轨空间；量能 0.46 倍，反弹质量尚可。

【盘面主线】
一是量能。十币 24h 成交全部低于七日均量，区间 0.05–0.46 倍，BTC 0.18、ETH 0.09。周末流动性稀薄，价格波动更多是撮合空隙，而不是真实共识。
二是分层。LINK 与 TON 站上 MA7，BNB 守住 MA99，其余七币全部 MA7 低于 MA25 且价格在 MA25 下方 3%–13%。这不是普跌，是资金向少数标的收缩。
三是位置。BTC 布林位置 -2.6%、SOL -3.3%，两大主流同时跌出下轨，属于超卖但未止跌的形态；而 ADA、AVAX、DOGE 的 30 日分位仍在 10%–12% 的深水区，没有像样的底部结构。

【操作参考】
多头条件：BTC 需 4h 收在 78110（24h 高）上方并伴随量能回升，才确认 76326 双底有效，目标看 MA7 79339；LINK 站上 11.749 可看 12.99 上轨。不做左侧接刀。
空头条件：BTC 有效跌破 76326（30 日低）且量能放大，则 MA99 76442 一并失守，ATR 1962 意味着单日仍有 2.5% 的宣泄空间；SOL 破 92.34 同理。
中性做法：美盘开盘前不加仓，等 21:30 后欧美资金交接的方向。周末盘薄，任何方向的假突破概率都翻倍。

【风险提示】
隔夜三个点。一、BTC 76326 是 30 日低与 24h 低的同位点，二次测试若失败会触发止损盘连锁。二、TON 量能仅 5%、XRP 无量横盘，这类品种在薄盘里的插针幅度可能远超 ATR 5.81% 与 4.16%。三、十币 RSI 集中在 30–44，超卖不等于反转，若美盘带来新一轮风险偏好收缩，深水区的 ADA、AVAX、DOGE 仍有下探 30 日低的空间。
以上为盘面数据推演，不构成投资建议。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Profits: Fortune Favors the Bold, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Rolling profits has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【How Rolling Profits Works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for a new position and keep trading,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is staggering; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Reality】Rolling profits is essentially “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

title: 周六傍晚：早盘摸到约 7.81 万的反抽，傍晚又磨回 7.74
subTitle:
早盘那截一度摸到约 7.81 万的反抽，到傍晚公开行情里 BTC 大约 7.74 万（近 24 小时约 -0.7%），高点约 7.81 万、低点约 7.63 万——等于把上午那截红 K 又吐了一半回去，横着磨。ETH 约 2244（约 +0.7%），BNB 约 702（约 -0.5%），XRP 约 1.25（约 -0.8%），SOL 约 95.5（约 -1.9%）——大饼横着，SOL 明显更累。

公开报道里还有一笔更「冷」的账：周五美股现货比特币 ETF 净流出大约 6.4 亿美元量级，把前面几天的流入打断了。周末美股休市、链上和交易所流动性本来就薄；再叠上事件冲击后的修复节奏，傍晚这根走势更像「时间换空间」，不像早盘那种「一口气翻盘」。

结构上我更盯三件事：一是 7.63～7.65 万低点会不会被二次砸穿；二是 7.81 万附近那截反抽高点有没有人当真防守；三是 SOL / BNB 相对 BTC 的弱势会不会收窄——若周末继续弱，说明压力不只是大盘 beta。

我个人怎么读这个周六傍晚（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 把 7.74 万附近当成「急跌后的磨底区间」比当成「底部确认」便宜——早盘高点没站稳，方向还没写完。
2. ETF 流出是周五大盘风险偏好的余波，周一现金盘开盘前别急着把周末横盘当结论。
3. 周末顺序仍是：低点是否守住 → 有没有二次冲击新闻 → 周一美股与风险资产再验偏好。

你怎么看：这算「周末流动性薄、反抽自然回吐」，还是「7.7 万一带在攒周一方向」？评论区聊聊。

For a contract written in Solidity, who ultimately executes it?
EVM execution must be deterministic: the same input must produce the same result on every node, or the nodes won't be able to reach consensus.
When operating across EVM-compatible chains, addresses may look the same, but make sure you know which chain your assets are on.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, payable in $ETH . Current price: 2241.87.
Have you ever misunderstood this too?

#ETH

content:
Solidity 写的合约，最后是谁在执行？
EVM 的执行必须是确定性的：相同的输入在任何节点上都要算出相同的结果，否则节点之间没法达成一致。
在 EVM 兼容的各条链上操作时，地址看起来一样，但资产在哪条链上得看清。
在以太坊上调用合约，EVM 每执行一步都按指令计 Gas，以 $ETH 支付。现价 2241.87。

“BlackRock dumped $1.61 billion worth of ETH in October”—an account with 490,000 followers posted that too. I really can’t stand seeing this.

ETF net outflows mean investors are redeeming their shares. The issuer simply sells the coins as needed and returns the cash to them. BlackRock itself isn’t bearish; it collects management fees, and a shrinking fund hurts it more than anyone. Calling redemptions a “whale dump” is just meant to make you panic—and get you to click a few more times.

But the numbers themselves really are ugly, no sugarcoating it: spot ETH ETFs saw $1.61 billion in net outflows in October, their worst month since launch. It was the sixth month of net outflows this year. Another $156 million flowed out on October 30 alone, while spot BTC ETFs saw $643 million in outflows that same day.

My take is simple: institutions are running out of patience with the ETH “ETF story.” Nobody’s targeting you. What really matters is whether the outflows stop—not whose headline shouts the loudest.

#ETH #ETF

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back. On the other hand, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re almost as good as wiped out.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%,” but “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

Let’s talk about the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche’s C-Chain, and many Layer 2 networks are all EVM-compatible, so Ethereum wallets and development tools can usually be used directly.
To be honest, I hadn’t paid attention to this before either: before interacting with a contract, check the block explorer to see whether its source code has been verified. Be extra cautious with contracts whose source code isn’t public.
When you call a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes, paid with $ETH .
Don’t trade with borrowed money; the pressure can lead you to make poor decisions.

#ETH

【On-chain anomaly: 50 signatures, and smart wallets became a funnel】

The biggest thing to review about ETH this week isn’t its price action: it’s down 5.6% over seven days, yet still up 0.6% over 24 hours, and trading volume hasn’t shrunk. Binance’s $6.3 billion theft losses pushed crypto futures liquidations to $1.57 billion; attackers leveraged the 2025 upgrade to use 50 Binance signatures. Experts say EIP-7702 wasn’t the root cause, but it may have amplified the losses and bypassed withdrawal protections.

I initially leaned toward “a rebound after a high-volume selloff”—I got the direction right. I was wrong to think the security shock would be just half a day of sentiment; in reality, leverage piled on a second blow. The FNG is at 30, against a weekly average of 44. Despite the sharp drop, it hasn’t kept weakening. This kind of divergence has looked like a bottom in the past, but I only trust it when volume confirms it.

In practice, ordinary wallets are getting smarter, and permission chains are getting more complex. Binance, market makers, and wallet service providers will feel the pressure first. Audits, insurance, and risk management have real demand, and wallet automation has value too—it’s just that security costs can’t be hidden. The logic holds; “an upgrade is automatically bullish” doesn’t.

Next week I’ll be watching the aftershocks of the liquidations, whether trading volume stays active, and whether any new signs of on-chain permission anomalies emerge. My view has changed: a black swan isn’t just a candlestick; it’s an incident that can change how risk is priced. Smart people always say to keep a steady hand, but I’m still itching to trade. Are you brave enough to buy into this wave of sentiment?

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十月三十一日早间，以太坊现货价格报二千二百四十三点八九美元，过去二十四小时微涨约百分之零点三八。在比特币因安全事件和ETF资金流出而走弱的背景下，以太坊展现出了相对抗跌的特性。从小时级别K线观察，最近五根蜡烛在二千二百三十七美元至二千二百四十九美元之间波动，振幅仅约十二美元，显示市场处于极度缩量整理的状态。成交量在最近一个完整小时达到六百一十一万美元，较前一小时有所放大，但整体仍低于近期均值。

均线系统方面，当前价格位于七日指数移动均线二千二百四十三美元附近，与均线基本持平，略低于二十五日指数移动均线二千二百四十六美元，远低于九十九日指数移动均线二千二百八十九美元。价格被压制在短期均线下方，中期趋势依然偏弱。不过值得注意的是，七日均线已开始走平，若价格能向上突破二千二百五十美元，有望形成短期均线金叉。

二、技术指标解读

布林带指标显示上轨位于二千二百五十二美元，中轨约二千二百四十美元，下轨约二千二百二十八美元。价格在中轨附近窄幅波动，带宽极度收窄至仅二十四美元，这是典型的变盘前兆。考虑到以太坊近期波动率持续下降，一旦方向选择完成，可能出现较大幅度的单边行情。

MACD指标方面，快线位于负三点八七附近，慢线约负六点三七，柱状图为正二点五，连续多个周期保持正值并呈扩张态势。虽然MACD整体仍在零轴下方，但柱状图的持续放大表明空头动能正在快速衰减，短期金叉信号呼之欲出。RSI六周期指标从四十六回升至五十一附近，重回中性区域，与比特币的走势类似，短期超跌修复已基本到位。

KDJ指标显示K线降至四十九，D线位于五十四，J线降至三十八，三线均处于中低位区域，暗示短期可能酝酿反弹。威廉指标从负二十回落至负三十二，进入中性偏弱区域。抛物线SAR指标位于二千二百美元下方，对价格形成支撑。综合来看，以太坊的技术面呈现出底部蓄势的特征，反弹条件正在逐步成熟。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪目前呈现多空交织的格局。利好方面，大型交易所承诺全额覆盖安全事件损失并持续通过OTC和公开市场回购资产，为市场提供了结构性买盘支撑。同时，链上数据显示鲸鱼地址在波动期间通过OTC和去中心化交易所大量吸筹，反映出大户对以太坊中长期价值的信心。

利空方面，以太坊现货ETF已连续五天录得资金净流出，十月三十日单日流出一点五六亿美元，机构投资者的持续减仓对价格形成压制。此外，安全事件中被盗的约四十九万至五十万个以太坊仍滞留在去中心化流动性池中，构成了潜在的抛售压力。美联储鹰派信号同样对以太坊等风险资产构成宏观层面的压制。

不过从相对表现来看，以太坊在比特币下跌超过百分之一的情况下仍维持微涨，展现出一定的独立性和韧性。若比特币企稳反弹，以太坊有望凭借更优的技术面形态实现更快的反弹速度。

今日热门代币方面，LSK报零点二三一四美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十九点六五，受一亿枚代币销毁消息刺激；BEAMX报零点零零五零九三美元，涨幅百分之十八点四四；EDEN报零点零五七八六美元，涨幅百分之十五点五六。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell; then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out method I've been using.

【Three stages】First stage: at the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: at the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), take off another 1/3. Third stage: let the rest run with a trailing stop; exit if it breaks below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding the elevator back to where you started.

Let’s talk about the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the stack has a maximum depth of 1,024.
One thing worth thinking about: the EVM charges Gas for each instruction. If a transaction runs out of Gas, it is halted and its state changes are reverted. This prevents infinite loops from holding up the entire network.
Before interacting with a contract, check on a block explorer whether its source code has been verified. Be especially cautious with contracts whose source code isn’t publicly available.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every step it executes, at a rate of $ETH . The current price is 2244.

Does a sudden surge in trading activity always mean a confirmed direction for $ETH? Many traders assume that when relative volume is 2.69267, the current price move is guaranteed to continue. Why look at 4-hour, 1-hour, and 15-minute candlestick charts?

Many people keep falling into the same traps in the ⭕圈 because they focus on just one timeframe.
Today, I’ll explain the multi-timeframe candlestick trading method I often use. It’s three simple steps: determine the direction, find the levels, and choose the timing.
1. 4-hour chart: Decide whether to go long or short
This timeframe is long enough to filter out short-term noise and make the trend clear:
• Uptrend: highs and lows are both rising → buy the dips
• Downtrend: highs and lows are both falling → sell the rallies
• Sideways market: price keeps moving within a range, making it easy to get whipsawed. Frequent trading is not recommended.
Remember: following the trend improves your odds; going against it will only make you give your money away.
2. 1-hour chart: Define the range and find key levels
Once the overall trend is clear, the 1-hour chart can help you identify support and resistance:
• Areas near trendlines, moving averages, or previous lows may be potential entry points.
• As price approaches a previous high or major resistance, or a topping pattern appears, consider taking profit or reducing your position.
3. 15-minute chart: Use it only for the final “trigger pull”
This timeframe is for finding entry timing, not for identifying the trend:
• Wait for a short-term reversal signal at a key price level (an engulfing pattern, bullish divergence, or a golden cross) before entering.
• A breakout is more reliable when accompanied by rising volume; otherwise, it may be a fakeout.
How do you combine multiple timeframes?
1. Determine the direction first: Use the 4-hour chart to decide whether to go long or short.
2. Find an entry zone: Use the 1-hour chart to mark support or resistance areas.
3. Time your entry: Use the 15-minute chart to find the final signal before entering.
A few additional points:
• If the timeframes point in different directions, it’s better to stay out and wait than to take a trade you’re unsure about.
• Shorter timeframes move quickly, so always use a stop-loss to avoid getting stopped out repeatedly.
• Combining trend, price level, and timing works far better than staring at charts and guessing.#ETH

什么要看4小时、1小时、15分钟K线？

很多人在⭕圈反复踩坑，问题出在只盯一个周期。
今天讲一下我常用的多周期K线交易法，简单三步，把握方向、找点位、定时机。
一、4小时K线：决定你做多还是做空的大方向
这个周期足够长，能过滤掉短期杂音，清晰看到趋势：
•上升趋势：高点、低点同步抬升 → 回调低吸
•下降趋势：高点、低点同步降低 → 反弹做空
•横盘震荡：价格在箱体里反复，容易来回打脸，不建议频繁操作
记住一句话：顺势才有胜率，逆势只会送q
二、1小时K线：用来划区间，找关键位
当大趋势确定后，1小时图能帮你找到支撑/阻力：
•接近趋势线、均线、前低这些位置，是潜在的进场点
•逼近前高、重要阻力、顶部形态出现，就要考虑止y或者减仓了
三、15分钟K线：只做最后的“开枪动作”
这个周期专用来找进场时机，不是用来看趋势的：
•等关键价位出现小周期反转信号（吞没、底背离、金叉），再出手
•成交量放出来，突破才靠谱，否则容易假动作
多周期怎么配合？
1.先定方向：用4小时图选好做多还是做空
2.找进场区：用1小时图圈出支撑或阻力区域
3.精准进场：用15分钟图找临门一脚的信号
补充几点：
•如果几个周期方向冲突，宁可空仓观望，不做无把握的单
•小周期波动快，一定带止损，防止被反复扫掉
•顺势+位置+时机三者配合好，比盯着图瞎猜强太多#ETH

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? Here’s How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
It helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: if the stop distance is wide, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on any single trade remains

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Funding rates reveal bullish and bearish sentiment: learn to read three typical states
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we'll talk about how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often in the accelerating, topping-out phase, and a sharp long squeeze could happen at any moment. I'm not telling you to immediately
shorting. Instead: be extra cautious when going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major historical rallies started at times like this.

The Night I Got Liquidated on LSK

At three in the morning, my phone vibrated and jolted me awake from a light sleep. I grabbed it and glanced at the screen. My heart sank. LSK, 0.2550 USDT.

Just six hours earlier, I’d opened a short position with 20x leverage. LSK had fallen to 0.1765, and I’d stared at the candlestick chart for two whole hours. Every red candle seemed to tell me it would keep dropping. I remembered someone in the group saying LSK had weak fundamentals. I remembered how it had been sliding all the way down from its peak. I remembered the money I’d made shorting ETH last month.

I tapped “Short,” went all in, and put up 30,000 U in margin.

The moment I opened the position, I was almost excited. I thought I’d close it at 0.15 and make over 10,000. I poured myself a glass of water, lay down, and scrolled through posts on the forum. The whole feed was full of bearish opinions. I thought I was on the right side.

At one in the morning, LSK rebounded to 0.19. I reassured myself that it was a normal technical pullback and that the downtrend was still intact.

At two, it hit 0.21. I started getting restless, refreshing the chart over and over, my palms drenched in sweat. Someone in the group shouted that the whales were accumulating and we should get out. I gritted my teeth and held on, telling myself to wait a little longer. It would come back down.

At two-thirty, it reached 0.23. My unrealized loss had already topped 10,000 U. My finger hovered over the close-position button, trembling. I thought back to the year I first got into crypto, when I turned my 20,000 yuan into 80,000 and felt so happy. Then I remembered the six months that followed, when I lost it all, couldn’t sleep, and was afraid to check my account.

I told myself this time was different. This time, I’d done my homework.

At three, LSK surged like crazy to 0.255. When the liquidation notification popped up, I felt strangely calm. 30,000 U, gone. The numbers on the screen became a flat line, just like how I felt at that moment.

I turned off my phone and stared at the ceiling. A car drove by outside, its headlights casting a streak of light across the wall. I thought back to the first time I bought Bitcoin three years ago. A friend said it was a scam. That friend eventually got into crypto too—and lost even more than I did.

When morning came, I opened the exchange and took a look. LSK was trading at 0.2341, having fallen a little from its high. If I hadn’t been liquidated, if I’d just waited a little longer, maybe I could have made it back. But there are no “ifs” in the market.

I deleted the exchange app shortcut and went downstairs to buy breakfast. The soy milk was still hot, and the fried dough sticks were golden brown. I took a bite and suddenly felt that being alive mattered more than making money.

I paid 30,000 U for a lesson. I hope I really remember it this time.

我在LSK上爆仓的那个夜晚

凌晨三点，手机震动把我从浅睡中惊醒。我抓起手机看了一眼，心脏猛地一缩。LSK，0.2550 USDT。

就在六个小时前，我刚刚用二十倍杠杆开了空单。那时候LSK跌到了0.1765，我盯着K线看了整整两个小时，每一根阴线都像在告诉我，还会跌。我想起群里有人说LSK基本面差，想起它从高点一路下跌的走势，想起自己上个月在ETH上做空赚的那笔钱。

我点了做空，仓位梭哈，保证金三万U。

开单的那一刻，我甚至有点兴奋。我想着跌到0.15就平仓，能赚一万多。我给自己倒了杯水，躺在床上刷着广场上的帖子，满屏都是看空的声音。我觉得自己站在了正确的一边。

凌晨一点，LSK反弹到0.19。我安慰自己，这是正常的技术性回调，空头趋势没变。

两点，0.21。我开始坐不住了，反复刷新K线图，手心全是汗。群里有人喊，主力在吸筹，快跑。我咬着牙没动，跟自己说再等等，会回去的。

两点半，0.23。我的浮动亏损已经超过了一万U。手指悬在平仓键上，抖得厉害。我想起刚进币圈那年，两万块本金翻到八万的快乐。又想起后来亏光的那半年，每天失眠，不敢看账户。

我告诉自己，这次不一样，这次我做了功课。

三点，LSK像疯了一样拉升到0.255。爆仓通知弹出来的时候，我反而平静了。三万U，没了。屏幕上的数字变成了一条直线，就像我此刻的心情。

我关掉手机，盯着天花板。窗外有辆车开过去，车灯在墙上划出一道光。我想起三年前第一次买比特币的时候，朋友说这玩意儿是骗局。后来那个朋友也进了圈，亏得比我更多。

天亮的时候，我打开交易所看了一眼。LSK最新价0.2341，从最高点回落了一些。如果我没爆仓，如果我再等等，也许还能回来。但市场没有如果。

我删掉了交易所的快捷方式，去楼下买了份早餐。豆浆还是热的，油条炸得金黄。我咬了一口，突然觉得活着比赚钱重要。

三万U买了个教训。希望这次，我真的能记住。

📰 Meituan-backed wallet OnePay lets users deposit USDC directly into checking accounts: Why are banks racing to become the “utilities” of crypto?

OnePay, a Walmart-backed crypto wallet, has launched a feature that lets users transfer USDC directly into a bank checking account. This simplifies the bridge between crypto funds and the real world, and could bring stablecoins into everyday banking services like water and electricity. It’s convenient for users looking to cash out crypto assets or move them into the banking system, but for regulators and banks, it signals that stablecoins are poised to permeate the financial system.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying issue is the “last mile” between crypto assets and traditional finance. Previously, users had to transfer USDC through an exchange, a cumbersome process that could involve compliance risks. OnePay now lets users complete the transaction directly in a banking app, effectively giving crypto assets access to a bank-level service similar to cash for the first time. This reflects a broader trend of crypto assets moving beyond a “niche” and into the mainstream, as well as banks’ ambition to seize opportunities in emerging areas of financial technology.

Many countries have recently been discussing how stablecoins should be held in banks. For example, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently said that the issue of bank accounts for cryptocurrencies needs to be addressed. While OnePay’s move is still limited to the United States, it suggests that the integration of stablecoins into banking could start with retail-scale applications and accelerate from there. For banks, this is both a way to mitigate regulatory risks (since USDC is a compliant currency) and a new way to attract customers and generate profits.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could boost sentiment toward USDC and crypto products offered by banks, since making crypto easier to use is an essential industry need. Over the longer term, this could accelerate the use of stablecoins as a store of value, benefiting USDC, but it may not directly drive up BTC or ETH. That’s because BTC and ETH are viewed more as speculative assets, so the news would affect them mainly indirectly—for example, by demonstrating that crypto assets can enter the banking system more easily and reducing the risk of some funds flowing out.

Similar developments in the past include Bitpanda and Revolut allowing customers to buy and sell cryptocurrencies and deposit them into bank accounts. But OnePay’s direct connection to bank checking accounts takes things a step further. This suggests that crypto’s integration into banking could follow a “utilities” model, like water and electricity, rather than a purely financial investment model. This poses a challenge for regulators, because the more convenient banking services become, the greater the risk of regulatory arbitrage.

How to approach it
This news has more direct significance for the stablecoin market and could be a sentiment-driven positive for BTC and ETH. But note that if regulations tighten in the future or banks are unwilling to cooperate, this thesis no longer holds. October 31, 2026

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the afternoon of October 31, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,241, down approximately 0.5% over the past 24 hours. Compared with Bitcoin’s decline, Ethereum has shown some resilience, but overall it remains in a weak position.

Looking at the moving averages, the current price is slightly below the 7-period moving average of $2,243 and the 25-period moving average of $2,246, and well below the 99-period moving average of $2,304. However, the 99-period moving average forms strong resistance above $2,300, making a near-term breakout difficult.

Ethereum spot ETFs recorded net outflows of $155.7 million on October 30, extending the $105.5 million in outflows seen on October 29. Two consecutive days of institutional withdrawals have continued to weigh on the price. However, on-chain data shows that large holders are buying the dip. II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The MACD indicator shows the MACD line at -4.87, the signal line at -7.72, and the histogram at +2.85. As with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s MACD histogram has remained positive, indicating that bearish momentum is fading. However, the MACD line itself is still deep in negative territory, and there is no clear reversal signal yet.

As for RSI, the 6-period RSI is 54.16, back above 50; the 12-period RSI is 49.01, near the midpoint; and the 24-period RSI is 45.30, remaining weak. Short-term indicators are improving faster than medium- and long-term ones, suggesting that buyers have been stepping in at lower levels recently, but a trend reversal has not yet taken shape.

The Bollinger Band upper, middle, and lower bands are at $2,251, $2,239, and $2,227, respectively. The price is moving in a narrow range above the middle band, and the bands are extremely tight. For the KDJ indicator, the K-line is at 52.47, the D-line at 57.47, and the J-line at 42.46. The J-line is clearly below both the K-line and the D-line, forming a somewhat bearish signal. The greatest pressure currently facing Ethereum comes from selling pressure triggered by the security incident. Taken together, technical indicators suggest that Ethereum has formed a short-term support range between the lower Bollinger Band at $2,227 and the SAR at $2,197. 以太坊市场深度分析：黑客事件阴影下的低位盘整

2026年10月31日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月三十一日下午，以太坊报价两千两百四十一美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点五。相比比特币的跌幅，以太坊表现出一定的抗跌性，但整体仍处于弱势格局。

从均线系统来看，当前价格略低于七周期均线两千两百四十三美元和二十五周期均线两千两百四十六美元，远低于九十九周期均线两千三百零四美元。与比特币不同的是，以太坊价格仍略高于二十五周期均线，显示短期支撑相对更强。然而，九十九周期均线在两千三百美元上方形成强阻力，短期内突破的难度很大。

以太坊现货ETF在十月三十日录得一亿五千五百七十万美元的净流出，延续了十月二十九日一亿零五百五十万美元的流出态势。连续两天的机构资金撤离对价格形成持续压制。不过，链上数据显示大户在低位有抄底行为，私人托管钱包出现大额提币，每小时净流入达到五千五百六十万美元，这在一定程度上缓冲了下行压力。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标显示MACD线位于负四点八七，信号线位于负七点七二，柱状图为正二点八五。与比特币类似，以太坊的MACD柱状图也连续为正，空头动能在衰减，但MACD线本身仍处于深度负值区域，反转信号尚不明确。

RSI方面，六周期RSI为五十四点一六，已回到五十上方；十二周期RSI为四十九点零一，接近中轴；二十四周期RSI为四十五点三零，仍偏弱。短周期指标的改善速度快于中长周期，表明近期有资金在低位承接，但尚未形成趋势性反转。

布林带上轨两千二百五十一美元，中轨两千两百三十九美元，下轨两千两百二十七美元。价格在中轨上方窄幅波动，带宽非常紧凑。ATR指标降至十五点二一，为近期低位，显示市场波动率极度收缩。这种低波动状态通常是大行情的前兆，投资者需要做好方向性突破的准备。

KDJ指标中K线五十二点四七，D线五十七点四七，J线四十二点四六。J线明显低于K线和D线，形成一定的看跌信号。抛物线SAR位于两千一百九十七美元，低于当前价格，这是目前少数偏多的技术信号之一。SuperTrend位于两千两百八十二美元，高于价格，维持看空判断。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的最大压力来自安全事件引发的资产抛压。据链上追踪，攻击者已通过Aave将部分被盗稳定币转换为以太坊，目前在链上持有约四十二万至五十万枚被盗ETH。这些资产分布在无法冻结的去中心化地址中，形成长期的潜在抛售压力。

从宏观环境看，美联储的鹰派立场对以太坊同样构成压制。利率维持高位且存在进一步加息预期，降低了风险资产的吸引力。不过，纽约证券交易所母公司ICE宣布与Hyperliquid合作将永续合约引入美国市场的消息，为整个加密生态带来了一定的正面情绪。

技术面综合来看，以太坊在两千两百二十七美元的布林带下轨和两千一百九十七美元的SAR之间形成了短期支撑区间。若能守住这一区间并放量突破两千两百五十一美元的布林带上轨，则有望向两千三百美元发起挑战。反之，若跌破两千两百二十七美元，则可能测试两千两百美元整数心理关口。当前建议观望为主，等待波动率扩张后的方向确认。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
One term you can't avoid when trading perpetual contracts is the funding rate. It's settled every 8 hours and is
a payment exchanged between longs and shorts. The exchange simply collects and distributes it; it doesn't profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

【The smarter ETH gets, the more cautious we should be about wallets】

EIP-7702 isn’t malicious code, so why might it have amplified the losses this time?

Here’s what happened: the attacker obtained 50 signatures from Binance’s own wallet. Experts believe the attack might have succeeded even without EIP-7702, but this upgrade—which makes ordinary wallets smarter—may have helped the attacker bypass withdrawal protections.

EIP-7702 is like giving an account a “manager”: a wallet can delegate execution rights to a contract. That’s convenient, but it also brings complications: the more powerful automated trading becomes, the more robust permission boundaries, withdrawal risk controls, and anomaly monitoring need to be.

In practice, exchanges, custodians, and wallet service providers will all need to invest more in security. Users also can’t assume that an address is safe just because it looks normal. The more widely the standard is adopted, the greater the commercial value of permission management; a single vulnerability could also wipe out years of trust. The math adds up—it’s just that growth has often overshadowed these costs in the past.

ETH is around $2,254, up 1.4% in 24 hours and down 3.5% over seven days. The Fear Index is at 30, and trading volume is low. I’d call this “stabilizing amid fear,” not a confirmed reversal.

What matters for investment decisions is this: don’t just watch price support levels. Also consider whether the technical upgrade is creating real value—or first expanding the risk surface.

Remember this: a smart wallet’s moat isn’t greater convenience, but the ability to clearly explain permissions, monitoring, and accountability when something goes wrong.

Can these delegated-permission wallets really become a mass-market gateway to Web3? I’d rather hear what people working hands-on with them think.

#ETH #加密分析 #SP #Market Insights

【ETH越智能，为什么钱包反而更值得警惕？】

EIP-7702明明不是攻击代码，为什么却可能成了这次损失的放大器？

先讲个事：攻击者拿到了币安自身钱包的50份签名。专家认为，没有EIP-7702也可能得手，但这项让普通钱包更智能的升级，可能帮助其绕过提现保护。

EIP-7702像给账户配了个“管家”：钱包可以把执行权委托给合约。方便是方便，麻烦也来了——自动化交易越强，权限边界、提现风控和异常监控越要跟上。

落到实处，交易所、托管商、钱包服务商都得增加安全投入，用户也不能把“地址正常”当成安全。标准越普及，授权管理的商业价值越大；漏洞一次，也可能吞掉多年信任。这笔账算得通，只是过去常被增长掩盖。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。
