ETH测试网升级延期｜Hoodi仍无新日期｜我等2260确认

我的态度是观望。以太坊基金会10月22日明确宣布，原定10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活的Glamsterdam升级推迟，新的激活日期尚未确定；原计划同步把Hoodi区块Gas上限提高至2亿，也从日程中移除。基金会给出的原因，是核心开发者还要调查EIP-8037与主网智能合约的交互。此前10月16日公告列出的旧时点和节点操作说明已被新公告覆盖，不能再把它当作即将执行的时间表。

我关心的是市场会不会把“测试网延期”误读成“主网出故障”。官方写得很清楚：这次调整针对Hoodi，既没有设定Glamsterdam主网激活日期，也无需ETH持有人采取操作。它并不意味着以太坊现有主网停摆。真正的影响是扩容路线的验证节奏：区块级访问列表、提议者与构建者分离，以及更贴近执行和状态增长成本的Gas定价，都需要开发者在测试网验证后才能讨论后续部署。延期延长的是不确定性，不是已经发生的链上损失。

市场反应也要分开看。截至北京时间今晚约21时，Kraken的ETH/USD约2245美元，24小时区间约2204至2259美元，日内仅在区间里反复；不能凭这段价格波动断言是10月22日测试网公告造成的。同期风险偏好、ETF资金和交易所安全事件也会影响ETH。我的观察位是2259至2260美元的上沿和2204美元的下沿：上沿站不稳，利好叙事很难转化为可执行趋势；跌破下沿，则短线防守优先。若官方公布新Hoodi时间并完成客户端验证，且ETH重新站稳2260，我会提高对后续升级预期的信心；若调查扩大或价格跌破2204，这个偏多条件就被推翻。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与，方向暂定为等待确认后的现货试多，仓位上限为总资金3%，不用杠杆。入场触发是官方发布新的Hoodi安排，同时ETH连续两根一小时K线收在2260美元上方；少一个条件都不下单。若触发，第一目标2290美元，先减一半；第二目标2330美元，再减余仓的一半，剩余仓位以一小时收盘跌回2260平仓。初始止损放在入场价下方约2%，并以2204美元失守为强制退出条件。若先跌破2204而未触发入场，计划作废，继续空仓等待，不把计划写成成交。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.content:
Optimum’s mump2p has been all over my timeline these past couple of days, so let me say this upfront: the technology may be real, but most of the accounts hyping it are just farming airdrops.

Now for the serious part. mump2p uses RLNC (Random Linear Network Coding) to speed up Ethereum block propagation. It doesn’t change the consensus rules and runs in parallel with the existing GossipSub. It went live on mainnet on October 20. According to the official figures, over one week, blocks arrived about 277 milliseconds earlier at p95, and propagation tightened by 3.2x. Blockdaemon put together a case study involving 2185 validators, which showed a 39.7% drop in incorrect head votes. At least these figures are backed by specific validators, so I’m not going to dismiss them.

Then there’s the shilling. “Gmum fam! latency numbers are wild,” 14 views. “mump2p feels like my cheat code,” 2 views. Someone even said, “If validators aren’t running mump2p, they’re leaving money on the table.” But the project provides it to validators for free, so where’s that money coming from? Getting blocks a few hundred milliseconds earlier could help with MEV and attestations, but who has actually calculated the claim about “a lot of money”?

Then there’s that “Total Value Boosted.” One person says 2.49 million ETH, another says $3.4 billion in stake, and an X news summary says 3.36 million ETH. The figures change by the day. And this is the “amount of stake behind connected nodes,” not money locked in the protocol, so don’t treat it like TVL.

My take is simple: network-layer optimization is something Ethereum genuinely needs, and it’s worth paying attention to. But if a project’s Twitter buzz is mostly driven by a few dozen burner accounts all posting “what is mump2p” on the eve of Devcon, what you’re looking at is a task board, not consensus. If it launches a token one day, come back and check who these accounts were today.

#ETH #Optimum

content:
Optimum 的 mump2p 这两天在我时间线上刷屏，我先把话放这：技术可能是真的，但帮它喊的那群号，基本是在撸毛。

说正经的部分。mump2p 用 RLNC（随机线性网络编码）让以太坊区块传得更快，不改共识规则，跟原来的 GossipSub 并行跑。10月20日上主网，官方口径一周 p95 区块早到约 277 毫秒、传播收紧 3.2 倍。Blockdaemon 做了个案例，2185 个验证者，错误 head 投票少了 39.7%。这些至少是有具体验证者背书的数，我不黑。

然后看喊单区。"Gmum fam! latency numbers are wild"，14 浏览。"mump2p feels like my cheat code"，2 浏览。还有人直接说"验证者不跑 mump2p 就是把钱扔在桌上"，问题是项目方对验证者是免费提供的，钱从哪来？早几百毫秒拿到块对 MEV 和 attestation 有点用，但"大量的钱"这话谁算过？

再看那个"Total Value Boosted"。有人写 249 万 ETH，有人写 34 亿刀 stake，X 新闻摘要又写 336 万 ETH。口径一天一个样，而且这玩意儿是"接入节点背后的质押量"，不是锁进协议的钱，别把它当 TVL 看。

我的态度很简单：网络层优化是以太坊真缺的东西，值得关注。但一个项目的推特热度要是主要靠几十个 Devcon 前夕集体发"what is mump2p"的小号撑着，那你看到的是任务板，不是共识。等哪天它发币，记得回来翻翻今天这些号是谁。

#ETH #Optimum

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% of their time reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (what was your rationale?), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution), and
what you’ll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover: your losses...
Your trade log has lots of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.
